principles: title and narrative remain creative fields and are never replaced by mechanical local rules
field-count reduction is not evidence of quality improvement
deterministic derivation handles only identity, order, hashes, dependencies and lifecycle
required character motivation, conflict, event intent, agency and causal preparation remain in the bounded event input/obligation oracle
comparison records richness loss but cannot promote or mutate either authority
no aesthetic preference becomes a blocking validator

offline_qualitative_checks.name: obligation_retention
offline_qualitative_checks.method: sanitized fixtures label required motivation/conflict/intent/causal-preparation obligations; compare coverage without prescribing wording

offline_qualitative_checks.name: form_diversity
offline_qualitative_checks.method: valid terse, verbose, multilingual and genre-varied realizations must all remain acceptable when obligations hold

offline_qualitative_checks.name: richness_signal
offline_qualitative_checks.method: record meaningful character count, sentence count and labeled obligation count
offline_qualitative_checks.blocking: no universal minimum beyond structural meaningfulness; use for comparison evidence

offline_qualitative_checks.name: human_review_matrix
offline_qualitative_checks.method: offline reviewers classify missing intent, agency, conflict or causal preparation using fixture labels, not taste scores
offline_qualitative_checks.blocking: required before any later authority cutover design

draft_minimum_protection: Slice1 does not feed Draft; future integration must prove the sealed Draft minimum contract still carries motivations, conflicts, intentions and causal preparation before cutover
